stage: locked before new source retrieval or model output
selection: Two disjoint 24-hour calendar windows, fixed in advance to add separated time periods. No selection on Curve outcomes. Same three frozen task templates, thresholds and model arms.
schedule_per_window: 18 runs, three task templates, G and E, three repetitions
gate: Two matching bound source captures and independent human reference review before model execution. Log disagreements and failures. No substitution of dates after capture.
